description: Network Analysis of South African Commuter Railway Networks is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Johannes Jooste. This dataset contains the network analysis based on the network properties and characteristics of the South African Gauteng, Western Cape and KwaZulu-Natal Metrorail commuter rail networks. It also contains the information of 33 international metro railways reproduced from S. Derrible and C. Coverage: Gauteng, Western Cape and KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
